metadata.description: Official Glasser plugins — one key, no contract, pay per call, across paid APIs bought wholesale.

plugins.name: glasser
plugins.description: 1,000+ paid data endpoints behind one key: people and company enrichment, funding and hiring signals, SEO and keywords, Google SERP and shopping, local places, news, patents, tech stacks, and social media from providers like People Data Labs, Ahrefs, DataForSEO, Serper and Apollo. Your agent searches the catalog, sees the provider and Price before each call, and reports the charge after. Pay per call; failed calls and empty results cost $0.00.

plugins.name: glasser-research
plugins.description: Research companies, markets and the web inside Claude. Glasser connects Claude to live data on companies and prospects, search rankings and keywords, websites and online reviews, social profiles, local businesses, news and property records. Ask things like "What industry is example.com in and how many employees does it have?" or "Compare search visibility for example.com and a competitor", and Claude finds a suitable data endpoint, shows what it needs, and runs it once you approve.
